name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Pin shoulder blades back and down
Lower bar to mid-chest, forearms vertical
Drive feet into floor and press up
mistakes: Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees
Bouncing the bar off the chest

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set bench to about 30 degrees
Lower bar to upper chest below collarbone
Keep wrists stacked over elbows
mistakes: Setting incline too steep, turning it into shoulders
Lifting hips off the bench

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lock feet securely under the pads
Lower bar to lower chest with control
Press up and slightly back over shoulders
mistakes: Skipping a spotter on heavy sets
Letting the bar drift toward the neck

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Start dumbbells over chest, palms facing forward
Lower until elbows reach just below bench level
Press up and slightly in with control
mistakes: Clanging dumbbells together at the top
Dropping elbows too deep, stressing shoulders

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set bench at 30 degrees, back flat
Press up and slightly in over upper chest
Lower slowly until you feel a chest stretch
mistakes: Using a steep incline that overloads shoulders
Letting wrists bend back under the weight

name: Dumbbell Fly
cues: Keep a soft, fixed bend in your elbows
Open arms in a wide arc to chest level
Squeeze chest to bring weights together
mistakes: Straightening arms and turning it into a press
Lowering far past shoulder level

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
cues: Set bench to 30 degrees, press weights over chest
Open arms wide with soft elbows
Hug the weights together over upper chest
mistakes: Lowering too deep and straining the shoulders
Bending elbows more on every rep

name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest
Keep shoulder blades pinned against the pad
Press out without locking elbows hard
mistakes: Seat set too high, shifting load to shoulders
Letting shoulders roll forward at the end

name: Pec Deck Fly
cues: Keep upper back flat against the pad
Lead with elbows, bring arms together in front
Pause and squeeze chest, return slowly
mistakes: Using momentum to swing the handles
Letting elbows travel far behind the body

name: Cable Fly (Mid)
cues: Set pulleys at chest height, step forward
Hug a big tree with a soft elbow bend
Squeeze chest hard as hands meet
mistakes: Standing too upright, losing tension at the stretch
Bending elbows more on every rep

name: Cable Fly (High to Low)
cues: Set pulleys above head, lean slightly forward
Sweep hands down and together toward your hips
Squeeze lower chest at the bottom
mistakes: Pulling with arms instead of chest
Shrugging shoulders up toward ears

name: Cable Fly (Low to High)
cues: Set pulleys low, hinge slightly forward
Sweep hands up and together to chin height
Keep a slight bend, lead with the elbows
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift the weight
Letting hands rise above face height

name: Push-Up
cues: Keep body in a straight line, head to heels
Lower chest to floor with elbows at 45 degrees
Push the floor away, squeeze glutes tight
mistakes: Sagging hips or piking them up
Flaring elbows straight out to the sides

name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Place feet on a bench, hands under shoulders
Brace core to hold a rigid straight line
Lower chest to floor and press up
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag under the angle
Moving the head forward instead of the chest

name: Knee Push-Up
cues: Keep a straight line from knees to head
Lower chest to the floor, elbows at 45 degrees
Press up fully without locking elbows hard
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of the knees
Dropping head and neck toward the floor

name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Place hands on a bench, body in a straight line
Lower chest to the edge of the bench
Press away while keeping core braced
mistakes: Letting hips sag toward the bench
Shrugging shoulders up to the ears

name: Chest Dips
cues: Lean torso forward about 30 degrees
Lower until upper arms are parallel to floor
Press up without shrugging your shoulders
mistakes: Staying upright, shifting load to triceps
Dropping too deep, straining the shoulders

name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Lie across a bench holding one dumbbell overhead
Keep elbows slightly bent and arc weight behind head
Pull back over the chest, ribs down
mistakes: Bending elbows so it becomes a tricep extension
Arching the lower back at the stretch

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cues: Position bench so bar lands at mid-chest
Retract shoulder blades and keep feet planted
Press up and rack by rotating the bar
mistakes: Placing the bench too far forward or back
Locking elbows hard at the top

name: Deadlift (Conventional)
cues: Set bar over mid-foot, shoulders just ahead of bar
Brace core and pull slack out of the bar
Push the floor away, then lock hips and knees
mistakes: Rounding the lower back off the floor
Jerking the bar instead of pulling smoothly

name: Rack Pull
cues: Set pins just below the knees
Keep the bar dragging up your thighs
Squeeze shoulder blades together at lockout
mistakes: Leaning back past vertical at the top
Letting the bar drift away from the legs

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Stand centered in the bar, grip handles firmly
Keep chest up and push the floor away
Stand tall and squeeze glutes at the top
mistakes: Squatting too deep, losing hip drive
Shrugging shoulders up before the bar moves

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees, spine neutral
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs
Lead with elbows, squeeze shoulder blades together
mistakes: Standing up and heaving the weight with momentum
Rounding the upper back under load

name: Pendlay Row
cues: Start every rep with the bar on the floor
Keep torso parallel to the floor, back flat
Explode the bar to your lower chest
mistakes: Letting the torso rise during the pull
Resting too long on the floor between reps

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Brace one hand and knee on a bench
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not shoulder
Lower fully for a deep lat stretch
mistakes: Twisting the torso to swing the weight up
Shrugging instead of driving the elbow back

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Pull elbows back and up toward the ceiling
Squeeze shoulder blades and lower slowly
mistakes: Lifting chest off the pad to cheat
Using a short range of motion

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back, chest on pad
Pull handles toward your lower chest
Squeeze upper back and control the descent
mistakes: Rounding the lower back to move more weight
Jerking the weight with the hips

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a slight knee bend
Pull the handle to your belly button
Pause and squeeze shoulder blades together
mistakes: Rocking back and forth with the torso
Letting shoulders round forward on the return

name: Seated Row Machine
cues: Adjust the chest pad so arms reach fully
Pull handles back, driving elbows behind you
Hold briefly, then return under control
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders toward ears while pulling
Leaning back to finish the rep

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
cues: Stagger your stance and brace your core
Pull the handle to your ribs, elbow tucked
Rotate slightly at the end for full squeeze
mistakes: Over-rotating the torso to cheat the weight
Pulling with the biceps instead of the back

name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
cues: Grip wider than shoulders, thumbs wrapped
Lean back slightly and pull bar to upper chest
Drive elbows down and back toward your hips
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck
Swinging the torso to yank the weight

name: Lat Pulldown (Close Grip)
cues: Use a V-handle or shoulder-width neutral grip
Pull the handle to your upper chest
Squeeze lats and control the weight back up
mistakes: Letting the arms do all the pulling
Rounding the shoulders forward at the top

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip underhand at shoulder width
Pull the bar to your upper chest
Keep elbows close and chest lifted
mistakes: Leaning back too far like a row
Letting elbows flare out to the sides

name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
cues: Sit tall facing the high pulley
Pull elbow down toward your hip
Stretch fully at the top, squeeze lat at the bottom
mistakes: Tilting the torso sideways to move the weight
Cutting the stretch short at the top

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Hinge slightly and keep arms nearly straight
Sweep the bar down to your thighs
Squeeze lats and return slowly overhead
mistakes: Bending elbows and turning it into a pushdown
Using body momentum to move the bar

name: Pull-Up
cues: Start from a dead hang, shoulders packed down
Drive elbows to your ribs, chin over bar
Lower slowly to a full hang
mistakes: Kipping or swinging to gain momentum
Stopping short of a full hang

name: Chin-Up
cues: Grip underhand at shoulder width
Pull chest toward the bar, elbows tucked
Lower under control to straight arms
mistakes: Craning the neck to get the chin over
Half reps without reaching full extension

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Grip parallel handles, palms facing each other
Pull elbows down and back, chest to handles
Control the descent to a full hang
mistakes: Letting shoulders shrug up near the ears
Swinging the legs to create momentum

name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
cues: Choose assistance that allows a full range
Pull chest toward the handles, elbows down
Lower slowly, resisting the weight stack
mistakes: Using too much assistance and never progressing
Bouncing out of the bottom position

name: Inverted Row
cues: Keep body rigid from heels to head
Pull chest to the bar, squeeze shoulder blades
Lower under control to straight arms
mistakes: Sagging hips toward the floor
Leading with the chin instead of the chest

name: Back Extension
cues: Set pad just below your hip crease
Hinge forward with a neutral spine
Squeeze glutes to rise to a straight line
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Using momentum to swing up

name: Superman
cues: Lie face down, arms extended overhead
Lift arms and legs together using back and glutes
Hold one second, then lower with control
mistakes: Cranking the neck up to look forward
Using momentum instead of squeezing the back

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold the band at shoulder height, arms straight
Pull hands apart until the band touches your chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together, return slowly
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders up as you pull
Arching the lower back to finish

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Hold the bar at your thighs, arms straight
Lift shoulders straight up toward your ears
Pause at the top, lower slowly
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles
Bending the elbows to lift the bar

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Hold dumbbells at your sides, arms straight
Lift shoulders straight up, no rolling
Pause at the top, lower under control
mistakes: Rolling shoulders instead of lifting straight up
Using momentum from the knees

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace your core hard
Press the bar straight up, head moves through
Lock out overhead with ribs down
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press
Flaring ribs by overarching the lower back

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit with back supported, dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until arms are straight above shoulders
Lower to ear level under control
mistakes: Arching the back to push the weight
Flaring elbows too wide behind the body

name: Arnold Press
cues: Start with palms facing you at chest height
Rotate palms outward as you press overhead
Reverse the rotation smoothly while lowering
mistakes: Rushing the rotation and losing control
Leaning back to press heavier weights

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cues: Adjust seat so handles start at shoulder level
Press up without locking elbows hard
Lower slowly until upper arms are parallel
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders up to the ears
Lifting the back off the pad

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
cues: Place bench so bar travels just in front of face
Press up until arms extend fully overhead
Lower bar to chin level with control
mistakes: Sitting too far forward, pushing the bar out
Arching the lower back off the seat

name: Barbell Push Press
cues: Dip slightly at knees, keeping torso vertical
Drive up with legs and press the bar overhead
Lock out and stand tall before lowering
mistakes: Dipping forward instead of straight down
Pressing before the leg drive finishes

name: Landmine Press
cues: Hold the bar end at shoulder height
Press up and forward along the arc
Keep ribs down and core braced
mistakes: Leaning back to push the bar
Shrugging shoulders up at lockout

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with elbows, keep a slight bend
Raise arms to shoulder height, no higher
Lower slowly and keep tension on delts
mistakes: Swinging the torso to heave the weights
Shrugging traps instead of lifting with delts

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Stand side-on to a low pulley
Raise arm out to shoulder height, elbow leading
Resist the cable on the way down
mistakes: Leaning away to swing the weight up
Letting the cable slack at the bottom

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cues: Raise dumbbells in front to shoulder height
Keep a slight bend, palms facing down
Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Leaning back to heave the weights up
Raising above shoulder level, adding strain

name: Plate Front Raise
cues: Hold a plate at your thighs with both hands
Raise it in front to eye level
Lower under control, keeping ribs down
mistakes: Rocking the torso to build momentum
Letting the shoulders shrug at the top

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back
Raise arms out wide with elbows slightly bent
Squeeze shoulder blades and lower slowly
mistakes: Using heavy weights that force momentum
Shrugging traps instead of using rear delts

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cues: Sit facing the pad, chest supported
Sweep arms back wide, elbows leading
Pause and squeeze, return slowly
mistakes: Gripping tight and pulling with the biceps
Using momentum to swing arms back

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Cross cables and grab the opposite handles
Pull arms apart at shoulder height
Squeeze rear delts without shrugging
mistakes: Bending elbows into a row
Standing too close, shortening the range

name: Face Pull
cues: Set rope at forehead height, thumbs back
Pull rope toward your face, elbows high
Squeeze and rotate hands outward at the end
mistakes: Going too heavy and leaning back
Pulling to the chest instead of the face

name: Upright Row
cues: Use a shoulder-width grip, bar close to body
Lead with elbows to about chest height
Lower slowly without letting the bar drift out
mistakes: Pulling elbows far above shoulder height
Using a very narrow grip that stresses wrists

name: Pike Push-Up
cues: Form an inverted V with hips high
Lower the top of your head toward the floor
Press back up keeping hips elevated
mistakes: Letting hips sink into a regular push-up
Flaring elbows wide, stressing shoulders

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Keep elbows pinned to your sides
Curl the bar up without swinging
Lower slowly to full arm extension
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift heavier
Letting elbows drift forward during the curl

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Grip the angled bars, elbows at your sides
Curl up and squeeze biceps at the top
Lower for two seconds to straight arms
mistakes: Leaning back to cheat the weight up
Cutting reps short at the bottom

name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Stand tall, palms forward, elbows at your sides
Curl one arm at a time, palm up
Lower under control without swinging
mistakes: Swinging hips to start the movement
Moving the elbows forward as you curl

name: Hammer Curl
cues: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other
Curl up keeping elbows fixed at your sides
Lower slowly, don't let weights swing
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbells with the shoulders
Letting wrists bend during the curl

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Set bench to 60 degrees, arms hang behind torso
Curl up without moving the upper arm
Lower slowly to feel the biceps stretch
mistakes: Letting elbows travel forward during the curl
Setting the bench too upright, losing the stretch

name: Concentration Curl
cues: Brace upper arm against your inner thigh
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, no swinging
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly
mistakes: Rocking the torso to lift the weight
Letting the elbow slide off the thigh

name: Cable Curl
cues: Stand close to a low pulley, elbows at sides
Curl the bar up and squeeze biceps
Resist the cable on the way down
mistakes: Leaning back to start the curl
Letting elbows creep forward as you lift

name: Preacher Curl
cues: Rest the back of your upper arms on the pad
Curl smoothly without lifting elbows off the pad
Lower until arms are almost straight
mistakes: Dropping fast into the bottom stretch
Lifting hips or chest off the bench

name: Spider Curl
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Let arms hang straight down, curl without swinging
Squeeze biceps hard at the top
mistakes: Letting the upper arms swing backward
Using momentum from the shoulders

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
cues: Face away from a low pulley, arm behind you
Curl the handle up, keeping elbow behind torso
Control the stretch back to a straight arm
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift forward early
Leaning forward and shortening the range

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Grip just inside shoulder width
Tuck elbows close to your ribs
Lower to lower chest, press straight up
mistakes: Gripping too narrow and straining the wrists
Letting elbows flare wide

name: Skull Crusher
cues: Keep upper arms vertical and still
Lower the bar toward your forehead slowly
Extend elbows fully without flaring them
mistakes: Letting elbows flare out to the sides
Moving the upper arms like a pullover

name: Tricep Pushdown (Rope)
cues: Pin elbows at your sides, slight forward lean
Push down and split the rope at the bottom
Return slowly until forearms are parallel
mistakes: Leaning over the stack to push the weight
Letting elbows drift forward during the push

name: Tricep Pushdown (Bar)
cues: Grip the bar shoulder-width, elbows tight to ribs
Press down until arms fully extend
Control the bar back up to chest level
mistakes: Using body weight to shove the bar down
Flaring the elbows out wide

name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
cues: Face away from the pulley, elbows by your ears
Extend arms forward until fully straight
Lower slowly behind the head to stretch
mistakes: Flaring elbows wide as you extend
Arching the lower back during the press

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower behind the head, elbows pointing forward
Extend up and squeeze triceps at the top
mistakes: Letting elbows flare out to the sides
Arching the lower back as the weight rises

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
cues: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor
Extend forearm back until the arm is straight
Squeeze triceps, then lower without swinging
mistakes: Dropping the elbow as you extend
Swinging the weight with momentum

name: Tricep Dips
cues: Keep torso upright and elbows tucked back
Lower until upper arms are parallel to floor
Press up and lock out without shrugging
mistakes: Flaring elbows wide, stressing the shoulders
Leaning forward and loading the chest

name: Bench Dips
cues: Place hands on the bench behind you
Lower hips until elbows reach 90 degrees
Press up and squeeze triceps at the top
mistakes: Sliding hips far away from the bench
Dropping too deep, straining the shoulders

name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Make a diamond with thumbs and index fingers
Keep elbows close to ribs as you lower
Press up while holding a straight body line
mistakes: Letting elbows flare out wide
Sagging hips toward the floor

name: Wrist Curl
cues: Rest forearms on your thighs, palms up
Curl the weight up using only the wrists
Lower slowly to a full stretch
mistakes: Lifting forearms off the thighs
Using too heavy a weight with a short range

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
cues: Rest forearms on thighs, palms facing down
Lift the back of the hands toward the ceiling
Lower slowly and keep forearms still
mistakes: Using heavy weights that limit range
Letting elbows lift off the legs

name: Reverse Curl
cues: Use an overhand grip at shoulder width
Curl the bar up without swinging
Lower slowly keeping wrists straight
mistakes: Letting the wrists bend backward
Swinging the torso to lift the bar

name: Farmer's Walk
cues: Pick up heavy weights and stand tall
Walk with short, quick steps, shoulders back
Keep the core braced and weights steady
mistakes: Letting shoulders round forward under the load
Shrugging up and leaning side to side

name: Dead Hang
cues: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders
Pack shoulders down, don't shrug to your ears
Breathe steadily and hold until grip fades
mistakes: Swinging the body during the hold
Letting shoulders collapse up into the ears

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Brace core, bar on upper traps, chest up
Push knees out over toes as you descend
Drive through mid-foot, stand up tall
mistakes: Knees caving inward on the way up
Letting heels lift or the lower back round

name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Rest bar on front delts, elbows high
Keep torso upright as you sit between hips
Drive up leading with the chest
mistakes: Letting elbows drop and the bar roll forward
Rounding the upper back at the bottom

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the weight at your chest, elbows down
Sit between your hips, knees tracking toes
Stand up driving through the whole foot
mistakes: Letting the chest fall forward
Rising up onto the toes at the bottom

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rear foot on bench, front foot a long step out
Lower straight down, front knee tracks the toes
Drive through the front heel to stand
mistakes: Standing too close, pushing the knee far forward
Leaning the torso too far forward

name: Walking Lunge
cues: Step long and drop the back knee toward floor
Keep torso upright, front knee over the ankle
Push through the front heel into the next step
mistakes: Taking short steps that overload the knee
Letting the front knee cave inward

name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back and lower the rear knee toward floor
Keep chest up, weight in the front heel
Push off the front foot to return
mistakes: Letting the front knee collapse inward
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Place the whole foot on the box
Drive through the front heel to stand up
Lower slowly, don't drop down
mistakes: Pushing off the back foot to help
Using a box too high, rounding the back

name: Leg Press
cues: Place feet shoulder-width, mid-platform
Lower until knees reach roughly 90 degrees
Press through whole foot, don't lock knees
mistakes: Letting the lower back lift off the pad
Locking the knees hard at the top

name: Hack Squat
cues: Place shoulders under pads, feet shoulder-width
Lower deep with knees tracking over the toes
Press through your whole foot to stand
mistakes: Heels lifting off the platform
Bouncing out of the bottom position

name: Leg Extension
cues: Align knees with the machine pivot point
Extend legs until quads fully contract
Lower slowly, don't let the stack crash
mistakes: Swinging the weight with momentum
Lifting hips off the seat at the top

name: Smith Machine Squat
cues: Place feet slightly forward of the bar
Sit back and down keeping chest up
Drive through the heels to stand
mistakes: Feet too far forward, stressing the knees
Rounding the lower back at the bottom

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Stand shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit hips back and down, chest tall
Drive through whole foot to stand up
mistakes: Knees collapsing inward on the way up
Heels lifting off the floor

name: Pistol Squat
cues: Extend one leg forward, arms out for balance
Sit down on the standing leg slowly
Drive through the heel to stand up
mistakes: Heel lifting off the floor at the bottom
Dropping quickly into the bottom position

name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel
Keep knees stacked over ankles
Press through heels and breathe steadily
mistakes: Letting hips sink above parallel
Resting hands on the thighs

name: Jump Squat
cues: Squat to parallel, then explode upward
Land softly on the mid-foot with bent knees
Reset your stance before the next jump
mistakes: Landing with locked knees
Letting knees collapse inward on landing

name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Step wide to the side, sit hips back
Keep the trailing leg straight, feet flat
Push off the bent leg to return
mistakes: Rounding the back as you sit
Lifting the heel of the bent leg

name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Keep soft knees, push hips straight back
Keep the bar sliding along your legs
Squeeze glutes to stand once hamstrings stretch
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower
Bending knees into a squat

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold dumbbells at thighs, soft knees
Push hips back until hamstrings stretch
Keep weights close, then drive hips forward
mistakes: Rounding the upper back at the bottom
Letting dumbbells drift away from the legs

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
cues: Keep legs nearly straight with a slight bend
Hinge at hips, bar close to legs
Lower until hamstrings stretch, then stand
mistakes: Rounding the lower back to go deeper
Locking knees hard and hyperextending

name: Good Morning
cues: Bar on upper back, soft knees, chest up
Push hips back until torso is near parallel
Squeeze glutes to return to standing
mistakes: Rounding the back as you bend forward
Bending knees and turning it into a squat

name: Seated Leg Curl
cues: Adjust pad just above your heels
Curl heels toward your glutes fully
Return slowly without letting the stack drop
mistakes: Lifting hips off the seat to cheat
Rushing the lowering phase

name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Align knees just off the bench edge
Curl heels toward glutes, hips pressed down
Lower slowly until legs nearly straighten
mistakes: Lifting the hips to swing the weight
Using momentum with a short range

name: Nordic Curl
cues: Anchor your ankles and kneel tall
Lower forward slowly, hips and body in line
Use hands to push back up if needed
mistakes: Bending at the hips as you lower
Dropping fast with no control

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hinge on one leg, back leg extends behind
Keep hips square and spine neutral
Drive hips forward to stand tall
mistakes: Opening the hips toward the ceiling
Rounding the back to reach lower

name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
cues: Upper back on bench, bar over hip crease
Drive through heels, ribs down, chin tucked
Squeeze glutes hard at full hip extension
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top
Pushing through the toes, loading quads

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, feet flat near glutes
Drive hips up by squeezing your glutes
Hold the top, then lower with control
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of squeezing
Pushing through toes instead of heels

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Extend one leg, plant the other foot flat
Drive hips up, keeping them level
Squeeze the glute and lower slowly
mistakes: Letting hips rotate or drop sideways
Overarching the back at the top

name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Face away from the cable, rope between legs
Push hips back with soft knees
Drive hips forward and squeeze glutes
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging at the hips
Pulling with the arms rather than hips

name: Hip Abductor Machine
cues: Sit back with pads on outer thighs
Push knees outward in a smooth arc
Pause, then return slowly under control
mistakes: Using momentum to bounce the pads
Leaning forward to cut the range

name: Hip Adductor Machine
cues: Sit tall, pads on inner thighs
Squeeze legs together smoothly
Return slowly without slamming the weight stack
mistakes: Using too much weight with a short range
Rocking the torso to push the pads

name: Cable Glute Kickback
cues: Attach cuff to ankle, hinge slightly forward
Kick the leg straight back, squeezing the glute
Control the return without arching the back
mistakes: Swinging the leg and arching the lower back
Rotating the hips open to lift higher

name: Donkey Kick
cues: Start on hands and knees, core braced
Lift one bent leg toward the ceiling
Squeeze glute at top, lower without dropping
mistakes: Arching the lower back to lift higher
Letting the hips twist sideways

name: Banded Lateral Walk
cues: Place the band above knees, slight squat
Step sideways keeping tension on the band
Keep toes forward and knees pushed out
mistakes: Letting knees cave in as you step
Standing too tall and losing tension

name: Deadlift (Sumo)
cues: Take a wide stance, toes pointed out
Pull slack out, chest up, shins vertical
Push the floor apart and stand tall
mistakes: Hips shooting up before the bar moves
Knees caving inward off the floor

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
cues: Take a wide stance, toes out, hold one dumbbell low
Sit straight down, knees follow your toes
Squeeze glutes and inner thighs to stand
mistakes: Letting knees cave inward
Leaning forward and rounding the back

name: Curtsy Lunge
cues: Step one leg diagonally behind the other
Lower until the front thigh is parallel
Drive through the front heel to return
mistakes: Letting the front knee collapse inward
Twisting the torso as you step back

name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Place balls of feet on the platform edge
Lower heels for a deep calf stretch
Rise onto toes and pause at the top
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom of the rep
Bending knees to lift the weight

name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Pad on lower thighs, balls of feet on platform
Lower heels fully for a deep stretch
Press up high and squeeze for a second
mistakes: Cutting range short at the bottom
Bouncing instead of pausing at the top

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
cues: Stand on the edge of a step
Lower heels below the step for a stretch
Rise as high as possible and pause
mistakes: Rushing reps with a half range
Rolling to the outsides of the feet

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Hold a wall for balance, one foot on a step
Lower heel fully, then rise onto the big toe
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly
mistakes: Bending the knee to cheat the lift
Rolling the ankle outward at the top

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cues: Place balls of feet low on the platform
Press through the toes with knees nearly straight
Lower heels slowly for a full stretch
mistakes: Locking knees hard under heavy load
Using short, bouncy reps

name: Plank
cues: Place elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line
Squeeze glutes and brace abs hard
Breathe steadily, keep neck neutral
mistakes: Letting hips sag toward the floor
Piking hips up to ease the load

name: Side Plank
cues: Stack feet, elbow directly under the shoulder
Lift hips so the body forms a straight line
Keep hips from rotating forward or back
mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor
Rolling the chest down or up

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang with shoulders packed, avoid swinging
Raise straight legs until parallel or higher
Lower slowly without letting the body swing
mistakes: Swinging with momentum from the hips
Using hip flexors only with no ab curl

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang with shoulders active, legs together
Lift knees to chest, curling the pelvis up
Lower with control, no swinging
mistakes: Kipping with the legs to lift higher
Dropping down quickly after each rep

name: Crunch
cues: Lie back, knees bent, hands by your temples
Curl ribs toward hips, lifting shoulder blades
Lower slowly without resting your head
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with your hands
Using momentum rather than the abs

name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Hands behind head, lower back pressed down
Rotate elbow toward opposite knee as legs cycle
Extend the other leg low, move slowly
mistakes: Pulling on the neck to rotate
Rushing reps so the obliques don't work

name: Russian Twist
cues: Lean back with a flat spine, feet up
Rotate torso so hands touch each side
Move through the ribs, not just the arms
mistakes: Rounding the back to hold the position
Swinging arms without rotating the torso

name: Mountain Climbers
cues: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders
Drive knees toward chest alternately and quickly
Keep hips low and core braced
mistakes: Bouncing hips up high like a pike
Letting hands drift forward of the shoulders

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie flat, press lower back into the floor
Raise straight legs to vertical
Lower slowly, stopping just above the floor
mistakes: Arching the lower back as legs lower
Dropping legs quickly without control

name: Dead Bug
cues: Press lower back into the floor throughout
Lower opposite arm and leg slowly together
Exhale as you extend, keep ribs down
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor
Moving fast and losing core tension

name: Bird Dog
cues: Start on all fours, spine neutral
Extend opposite arm and leg without rotating
Hold a beat, then return under control
mistakes: Rotating the hips as the leg lifts
Arching the lower back at full extension

name: Hollow Hold
cues: Press lower back into the floor
Lift shoulders and legs a few inches up
Reach arms overhead, keep ribs pulled down
mistakes: Letting the lower back peel off the floor
Holding breath and tensing the neck

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel, tuck your pelvis and brace the abs
Roll out slowly while keeping the back flat
Pull back using abs, not the hips
mistakes: Sagging the lower back as you extend
Rolling out further than you can control

name: L-Sit
cues: Press the floor away, shoulders over hands
Lock knees and lift legs parallel to the floor
Keep ribs tight and hold the position
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders up toward the ears
Letting the legs sink below parallel

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel under the rope, hands by your head
Curl ribs toward hips, rounding the spine
Hold the squeeze, return without sitting back
mistakes: Pulling with arms instead of the abs
Sitting back on the heels to cheat

name: Ab Crunch Machine
cues: Adjust seat so pads sit across the chest
Curl torso forward by contracting the abs
Pause at the bottom, return slowly
mistakes: Pushing with hips or legs to move weight
Moving too fast with no squeeze

name: Cable Woodchop
cues: Set cable high, stand side-on, feet planted
Rotate through the torso, pulling diagonally down
Pivot the back foot, keep arms mostly straight
mistakes: Pulling with arms rather than rotating the torso
Twisting the lower back instead of the hips

name: Pallof Press
cues: Stand side-on, handle at chest, feet braced
Press arms straight out without twisting
Hold two seconds, then return to chest
mistakes: Letting the torso rotate toward the cable
Leaning away to counter the load

name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie back, knees bent at 90 degrees
Curl hips off the floor toward your ribs
Lower slowly without swinging the legs
mistakes: Swinging legs to lift the hips
Dropping hips down quickly

name: V-Up
cues: Lie flat with arms overhead and legs straight
Lift legs and torso together to form a V
Lower slowly, keeping legs straight
mistakes: Throwing the arms to build momentum
Bending the knees to make it easier

name: Flutter Kicks
cues: Lie back, lower back pressed into the floor
Lift legs slightly, kick alternately in small arcs
Keep abs tight and breathe steadily
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor
Kicking too high, losing core tension

name: Decline Sit-Up
cues: Hook feet under pads, arms crossed on chest
Curl up by contracting the abs
Lower slowly to the bench without collapsing
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands
Using hip flexors to throw the torso up

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
cues: Start in a high plank, feet wider than hips
Tap the opposite shoulder, keep hips level
Brace abs so the body does not rock
mistakes: Rocking hips side to side as you tap
Letting hips pike up

name: Heel Touches
cues: Lie with knees bent, shoulders slightly lifted
Reach to touch one heel, then the other
Keep shoulders off the floor and ribs tight
mistakes: Pulling the neck forward to reach
Dropping shoulders flat between touches

name: Burpees
cues: Drop hands down, jump feet back to plank
Lower chest to the floor, then press up
Jump feet in and leap up explosively
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank
Landing with stiff knees on the jump

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hinge back and hike the bell behind legs
Snap hips forward to float the bell up
Let the bell fall back, hinge again
mistakes: Squatting and lifting with the arms
Hyperextending the lower back at the top

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the bell by the horns at your chest
Sit deep between your hips, elbows inside knees
Drive up through heels and stand tall
mistakes: Letting the bell pull your chest forward
Knees caving inward on the way up

name: Kettlebell Clean
cues: Hike the bell back, hinge, keep the arm close
Snap hips and pull the bell up the body
Rotate hand around and catch in the rack
mistakes: Letting the bell crash on the forearm
Curling the bell with the arm instead of hips

name: Kettlebell Snatch
cues: Hinge back and swing the bell between the legs
Drive hips and pull the bell straight up
Punch through at the top, lock out overhead
mistakes: Swinging the bell wide, not close to the body
Letting the bell slam the wrist at the top

name: Turkish Get-Up
cues: Keep eyes on the weight throughout the movement
Move deliberately through each step, no rushing
Keep the arm vertical over the shoulder
mistakes: Letting the weighted arm drift or bend
Rushing steps and losing shoulder stability

name: Dumbbell Thruster
cues: Hold dumbbells at shoulders, squat to parallel
Drive up explosively through your legs
Use the momentum to press overhead, lock out
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish driving
Leaning back at the top of the press

name: Box Jump
cues: Swing arms and sink into a quarter squat
Jump up and land softly with bent knees
Stand fully on the box, then step down
mistakes: Jumping down off the box, stressing the Achilles
Landing with stiff, locked knees

name: Bear Crawl
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees hover an inch off floor
Move opposite hand and foot together
Keep hips low and back flat
mistakes: Raising hips up high while crawling
Taking wide, clumsy steps

name: Battle Ropes
cues: Set a quarter squat with a braced core
Whip the ropes with fast alternating arms
Keep waves flowing and the chest tall
mistakes: Standing upright and using only the arms
Letting waves die out from poor rhythm

name: Sled Push
cues: Lean into the sled with straight arms
Drive with powerful short steps
Keep the back flat and hips low
mistakes: Standing too upright and losing drive
Taking long steps and stalling momentum

name: Medicine Ball Slam
cues: Reach the ball overhead, rising onto your toes
Slam it down hard with a flexed spine
Squat to pick it up, keep chest up
mistakes: Using only the arms with no hip drive
Slamming without extending fully overhead

name: Treadmill Walk
cues: Stand tall, eyes ahead, arms swinging naturally
Land mid-foot with a relaxed stride
Avoid holding the handrails
mistakes: Gripping the rails and leaning back
Overstriding with heavy heel strikes

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
cues: Set incline between 8 and 12 percent
Walk with a tall chest and steady pace
Let arms swing, skip the rails
mistakes: Holding the handrails and leaning back
Taking oversized strides that strain the knees

name: Brisk Walk
cues: Walk tall with relaxed, swinging arms
Take quick, short steps at a steady pace
Breathe rhythmically, keep shoulders relaxed
mistakes: Hunching over the phone while walking
Overstriding and landing hard on heels

name: Run (Easy)
cues: Keep a pace where you can still talk
Land under your hips with quick, light steps
Relax shoulders and swing arms to the rhythm
mistakes: Starting too fast and fading early
Overstriding with a hard heel strike

name: Run (Tempo)
cues: Hold a comfortably hard pace you can sustain
Stay relaxed in the face, shoulders, and hands
Keep cadence quick with light mid-foot landings
mistakes: Surging early and fading in the final minutes
Clenching fists and tensing the shoulders

name: Sprint Intervals
cues: Warm up fully before any all-out sprint
Drive knees, pump arms, lean slightly forward
Walk or jog to recover between sprints
mistakes: Sprinting without a proper warm-up
Cutting rest short so quality drops

name: Cycling (Stationary Bike)
cues: Set seat height so knees stay slightly bent
Keep a smooth cadence around 80 to 100 rpm
Stay tall with relaxed shoulders and hands
mistakes: Seat too low, straining the knees
Gripping the handlebars tightly and hunching

name: Cycling (Outdoor)
cues: Check seat height and wear a helmet
Pedal in a smooth, steady cadence
Keep elbows soft and eyes up on the road
mistakes: Riding in too high a gear at low cadence
Locking arms and tensing the shoulders

name: Elliptical
cues: Stand tall, feet flat, hands lightly on handles
Push and pull smoothly through the full stride
Keep a steady resistance and cadence
mistakes: Leaning heavily on the handles
Letting the knees collapse inward

name: Stair Climber
cues: Stand tall with hands lightly on the rails
Step through the whole foot, driving through heels
Keep a steady pace without leaning
mistakes: Hunching over and gripping the rails
Taking tiny shallow steps

name: Rowing Machine
cues: Drive with legs first, then lean back
Pull the handle to lower ribs, elbows past body
Reverse the order: arms, torso, then legs
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs finish
Rounding the back at the catch

name: Skipping Rope
cues: Keep elbows close, turn the rope with the wrists
Jump low, landing softly on the balls of feet
Stay tall with relaxed shoulders
mistakes: Jumping too high and wasting energy
Swinging the rope with big arm circles

name: Swimming
cues: Keep body long and flat at the surface
Rotate hips and shoulders with each stroke
Exhale steadily underwater, breathe to the side
mistakes: Lifting the head and sinking the hips
Holding the breath until gasping

name: HIIT Circuit
cues: Work hard for 30 seconds, rest 30 seconds
Keep form clean even as you fatigue
Pick 4 to 6 moves and repeat rounds
mistakes: Going too hard early and fading fast
Letting form break down when tired

name: Badminton
cues: Stay light on your toes in a ready stance
Use a relaxed grip and snap the wrist
Recover quickly to the centre after each shot
mistakes: Standing flat-footed between rallies
Gripping the racket too tightly

name: Cricket
cues: Warm up shoulders, hamstrings, and hips first
Keep a stable base and watch the ball
Stay active between overs, don't stand still
mistakes: Skipping warm-ups before bowling or batting
Bowling through fatigue with poor technique

name: Football (Soccer)
cues: Warm up with dynamic stretches first
Stay on the move to create passing options
Land softly and stay aware of your knees
mistakes: Skipping warm-ups and straining the hamstrings
Wearing shoes without adequate grip

name: Jumping Jacks
cues: Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead
Land softly on the balls of the feet
Keep a steady rhythm with a tall chest
mistakes: Landing hard on heels with stiff knees
Letting the arms flop at half range

name: Hiking
cues: Take short, steady steps uphill
Use your legs and glutes, keep chest tall
Pace yourself and drink water regularly
mistakes: Starting too fast and burning out early
Hunching and looking down at your feet

name: Basketball
cues: Stay low in an athletic stance
Keep your head up while dribbling
Land softly and control each cut
mistakes: Landing stiff-legged after jumps
Standing still between plays

name: Shadow Boxing
cues: Stay on the balls of your feet
Rotate hips and shoulders into each punch
Keep guard up, return hands to the chin
mistakes: Locking elbows at the end of each punch
Dropping the non-punching hand

name: Assault Bike
cues: Set the seat so knees stay slightly bent
Push and pull handles in sync with legs
Brace core and keep shoulders relaxed
mistakes: Going all out right away and fading fast
Sitting hunched and gripping the handles hard

name: Yoga Session
cues: Move slowly and match breath to each pose
Press evenly through hands and feet
Never force a stretch, ease in gradually
mistakes: Forcing a pose beyond the comfortable range
Holding the breath during difficult poses

name: Full-Body Stretching
cues: Move into each stretch slowly until mild tension
Hold 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily
Release gently, never bounce at end range
mistakes: Bouncing into a stretch at end range
Stretching cold muscles without warming up

name: Foam Rolling
cues: Roll slowly over a muscle, about an inch per second
Pause on tender spots for 20 to 30 seconds
Keep breathing and avoid rolling over joints
mistakes: Rolling quickly without pausing on tight spots
Rolling directly over joints or the lower back

name: Surya Namaskar
cues: Sync each movement with an inhale or exhale
Keep hips lifted in downward dog, heels reaching
Move smoothly from pose to pose without rushing
mistakes: Rushing through poses without breath control
Collapsing the lower back in cobra

name: Cat-Cow
cues: Start on all fours, wrists under shoulders
Arch and round the spine slowly with breath
Move through the full spine, not just the neck
mistakes: Moving too fast without breath control
Collapsing into the shoulders

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Step into a deep lunge, hands inside the foot
Rotate the chest up toward the lead knee
Reach the arm high, then switch sides
mistakes: Letting the back knee collapse inward
Rushing through without reaching fully

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Kneel, tuck the pelvis, squeeze your back glute
Shift weight forward until the front hip stretches
Hold 30 seconds, breathing slowly
mistakes: Arching the lower back to feel more stretch
Letting the pelvis tilt forward

name: Open Book Thoracic Rotation
cues: Lie on your side with knees stacked
Open the top arm toward the floor behind you
Rotate through upper back, keep knees together
mistakes: Letting the knees separate during rotation
Forcing range from the lower back

name: Band Shoulder Dislocates
cues: Hold a band wide with straight arms
Raise it overhead and behind in an arc
Keep ribs down and move slowly
mistakes: Gripping too narrow, straining the shoulders
Bending the elbows to get past

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
cues: Hinge forward from hips with a flat back
Feel the stretch behind the thigh, not the back
Hold 30 seconds, breathing evenly
mistakes: Rounding the spine to reach the toes
Bouncing in the stretch

name: Child's Pose
cues: Sit hips back toward your heels
Reach arms forward, resting your forehead down
Breathe slowly into your lower back
mistakes: Forcing the hips down when they're tight
Holding the breath or tensing shoulders

name: Pigeon Pose
cues: Bring one shin forward, extend the back leg
Square hips to the floor, lengthen your spine
Fold forward slowly and breathe into the hip
mistakes: Letting the front knee take the strain
Twisting the hips off to one side
